what_to_detect: A resolution instructs a player other than the ability's controller to put an object onto the battlefield, and the object enters under the instructed player's control.
near_miss: A resolution in which the ability's own controller is the instructed player, so the object enters under the ability's controller.

what_to_detect: A permanent keeps its face status (flipped) while an effect makes it a copy of another card, so it shows the copied card's flipped characteristics.
near_miss: An unflipped permanent becomes a copy of a flip card and shows the copied card's unflipped characteristics.
